text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh… checking the menu. Hehe, such a serious face.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Just the usual you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …! Yes. Is your break over?
choice_data_list: <size=32>No, I just wondered if something was wrong...</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Eh? Ah… no, nothing at all! It just got a little warm, so I spaced out.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Oh right, you’ve got pool training after this, right? Good! Jumping in now would feel amazing.
choice_data_list: <size=32>(She’s a bit tense… if she can’t talk here…)</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Huh? A day off? Yeah, I’m free. Why?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Eh? You want to go back home? With me…?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Wow… it’s been so long…! Ah, look. That bookstore.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: We used to buy study guides together. And from that butcher shop, we’d get croquettes and share them…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: It’s all the same.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hehe, the grass is still overgrown. This place hasn’t changed either.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: We played hide-and-seek here all the time. You’d cover your eyes by that tree and count one, two…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You always hid in the same place. …Oh, you were doing that for me, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hehe, the truth is a secret? Then I won’t ask anymore.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: And we often prayed together too. For anything.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Hic… uuh… big brother scraped his knee… please… heal it quickly…!
choice_data_list: <size=32>May it heal cleanly so we can play like always</size>

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Hic… uuh… big sister scraped her knee… please… heal it quickly…!
choice_data_list: <size=32>May it heal cleanly so we can play like always</size>

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow’s sports day! Please make it bright and sunny! Hmmm!
choice_data_list: <size=32>I hope it’ll be perfect weather to run</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: They granted quite a lot of our wishes. Oh, let’s visit and thank them.
choice_data_list: <size=32>Yeah, they’ve taken care of us for so long</size>
<size=32>Yeah, they’ve taken care of us for so long</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Eh… really? Even recently?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I see. Then we definitely have to thank them!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hello! It’s been a while, ma’am!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Buena-chan and you! My goodness, you’ve both grown so much! I’m so happy you came!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I’m happy to see you again too. Um, do you still sell mugwort buns?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Of course, dear. You always loved them. Want some today?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …! Yes! Trainer, would you like the same?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. I also have yokan. It’s been your favorite lately, hasn’t it, big brother?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. I also have yokan. It’s been your favorite lately, hasn’t it, big sister?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Eh, yokan…? Didn’t you say before it was too sweet for you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I see, it is tasty! Then let’s get some of that too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Oh… that shop closed down…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I see… this place too…
choice_data_list: <size=32>You’re… not feeling much better, are you?</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ! No… or rather, I see. You were worried about me?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I wondered why you invited me… so that was the reason.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hey… can we stop by the shrine one more time? There’s something I want to pray for.
(Clang clang… clap clap)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (…I’m not a child anymore. I’ll become an adult quickly. I’ll overcome this loneliness.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (So please watch over me. So I won’t make you worry. So I can show you a bright smile…!)
(Clink)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Um, over here… ah, an ema fell! Maybe the string snapped…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hm? This handwriting… I’ve seen it…
It should be familiar handwriting. After all, it was something I wrote recently…!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: “May I become someone worthy of Buena.” …Eh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Hey, what does this mean? Can you… tell me?
I told her everything. The shock I felt when I saw how much she’d grown as a runner. How I studied desperately, prayed desperately, to stand beside that distant flower.
choice_data_list: <size=32>…I wanted to make it come true</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …You worked that hard… all while thinking that?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Even though we spent so much time apart. Even though so many things changed…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: <size=32>I always wished I could stay by your side</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …We were never apart.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You stayed just as you always were… your heart was always beside me…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Hey, what else?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah, hehe, sorry for asking suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to know. About you, when we were apart.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: About the you I didn’t know.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Sorry. I’m okay now. …I finally graduated.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Maybe… from being “Lonely Buu-chan”?
